reads: campaign brief (campaign_read): channel decisions, economics box, paid structure, test plan, targets — plan-campaign
picked statics: batch file ads/batches/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md + lower-case tag picked (ads_creative_read) — make-static-ads

maker hand-off files: ads/batches/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md (make-static-ads: copy, test structure, regulated flags); video copy comes from the marketer, and videos (goose-video, video_read) and the marketer's own files are claim- and policy-checked here at launch (claims-gate, ad-policy-check)
kept videos already made in GooseWorks (video_read with scenes for the script and on-screen text, video_share)
weekly performance read and data-quality flags (reports/performance/ in the brand coworker workspace) — analyze-performance
Meta account state for Goose objects (meta_read pages, performance, push_status, change_status)
change log ads/campaigns/<slug>/state.md (harness frontmatter, open recommendations) and decisions.md (### dated blocks) — its own plus the server's Meta outcomes
human: allowable cost if not derivable, budget ceiling, off-limits campaigns, exports from other platforms and non-Goose Meta, stock, offer changes
this week's input summary (reports/performance/inputs/<date>.md) — analyze-performance, to reuse exports
demand read research/market/demand.md — research-market (search keyword proposals)
its own last run record runs/run-paid-campaigns/weekly-ads-check/<slug>/<date>.md (scorecard, money moves with baseline recipes) — run-memory

Brand Brain (brain_map, brain_open, brain_search where listed): chapter 20 target_cpa / target_roas / decision.* / experiment.*, chapter 15, chapter 23 readouts, the operating plan (daily cap, protected entities, emergency stop)
analyze-performance's newest run record and report (store-joined numbers for the scorecard's return column)

the marketer's own ads-platform connector, when they have one: account-wide results, frequency, CPM, learning and delivery status, disapprovals, ads GooseWorks didn't make; store, CRM and billing connectors read-only

local mode: gooseworks-local/<brand-slug>/ (the approved plan in plans/<slug>/, brand-notes.md, its own state.md, decisions.md and run records) — the marketing-guide skill (../marketing-guide/SKILL.md) §5
writes: weekly moves proposal (chat) — the human approves
Meta approval-gated proposals (prepare_meta_ad_push, propose_meta_budget_change, propose_meta_creative_replacement) and pauses (pause_meta_ad_push) — server records pushes and changes
ads/campaigns/<slug>/state.md and decisions.md in the server's campaign-harness grammar — read by the server, analyze-performance and plan-campaign's replan
written-instruction cards for non-lever platforms and non-Goose Meta objects
rotation requests ads/campaigns/<slug>/rotation-requests.md — read by make-static-ads
optional weekly schedule (automation_upsert) that only stages proposals — on explicit yes
request lines (Rotation needed / Fix needed) in ads/campaigns/<slug>/rotation-requests.md — answered by make-static-ads

run record runs/run-paid-campaigns/weekly-ads-check/<slug>/<date>.md + brand document (keep-history) — per-ad scorecard, money moves with baseline recipes and verdicts, open moves — read by its own next run, analyze-performance and plan-campaign
proposal file ads/campaigns/<slug>/proposals/<date>.md (the weekly proposal, saved every run)
measured readouts (kind 23 experiment_readout.<slug>-r<n>, worked / didn't work only, never from a scheduled run) via save-learning

proposed targets (kind 20 target_cpa / target_roas via save-learning, the marketer's words) and a stated daily cap (operating_plan daily_spend_cap_minor_units / spend_cap_currency via brain_save) — wait for the marketer's yes
ads/method/ (copied method for the scheduled worker: SKILL, references, atoms, shared atoms) — read by the weekly automation

connector changes on the marketer's ads account, any platform (the connector rule in references/meta-levers.md: one card and one named yes each, read back, created paused, budget steps at most 30%) — logged in decisions.md
local mode: the same files under gooseworks-local/<brand-slug>/ — read by its own next run and analyze-performance in local mode

needs.gooseworks: optional — without it, local mode (the marketing-guide skill, ../marketing-guide/SKILL.md §5): an ads-platform connector the marketer has, or exports and written instructions
connectors_optional: ads-platform connector (reads; changes one named yes at a time)
